messages:
vivian: Heads-up — planned availability-zone failover drill + loadtest on Sat 04/11 02:00-04:00 UTC. Target pools: inference-edge-us-east-1-a/b. Purpose: validate cross-AZ routing, KV cache warmup, and autoscaling under cold-start churn.
mark: What's the failover mechanism? full AZ drain or node-level cordon?
vivian: We will drain at AZ level by cordoning and evicting nodes sequentially (a then b) to simulate AZ outage. Rolling policy: 10% traffic -> 50% -> 100% to fallback region for affected customers.
ryan: Do we have a temp routing plan for model variants? I recommend routing non-critical traffic to smaller quantized variants during the 50-100% stage.
vivian: Agreed. ops will push routing rule: route 20% to q4_0 for stateless models; pinned/dedicated will be exempt.
oncall: I'll be on for the window. Please page immediately on error spike >1.5% sustained for 5m.
ops-bot: Created runbook RB-AZ-DRILL-186523. Checklist uploaded: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/RB-AZ-DRILL-186523
release-bot: Canary job scheduled at 02:05 UTC: job id canary-az-186523. Will post results here.
mark: Customer comms? We need a short advisory and a separate note to Dedicated customers.
vivian: Maria from ops will send the external advisory tomorrow. Dedicated outreach list compiled (10 accounts); we'll offer opt-out until next maintenance window.
ryan: Preflight items:
``n- validate routing fallback rules in staging
- ensure autoscaler cooldowns are tuned for churn
- start cold-cache evict test (small scope)
- pre-create rollback policy in control plane
```
vivian: Metrics to watch during run: p99 latency, error rate, request success rate, pod restart counts, node drain time, tail latencies per-customer. Temporary SLO guardrail: p99 allowance +25% for drill window; no SLA changes.
oncall: Add prom alert: `DRILL-P99-SPIKE` threshold p99 > baseline*1.25 for 10m -> post to channel, page only if errors >1.5% for 5m.
ops-bot: Alert rule `DRILL-P99-SPIKE-186523` created.
release-bot: Canary executed: quick summary — p99 +10%, errors +0.4%, KV misses observed during node evictions. Logs: https://ci.internal/jobs/canary-az-186523/logs
mark: Looks ok for canary. Proceed to 50% ramp at 02:45 UTC.
ryan: Running a 5-min cold-cache eviction test now. Will report.
release-bot: 50% ramp complete: p99 +22% (within guardrail), errors +1.1% (slightly above internal page threshold but below customer SLA). Some models with large embeddings had slow warmups.
oncall: I saw a sustained error spike in one customer tenant for ~7m — tagging @vivian.
vivian: Noted. Which tenant?
mark: Tenant: express-ai-prod — pinned model lacked fallback, ops to open RI-2205 for postmortem and mitigation.
ryan: Add action: expand fallback catalog for pinned models where possible and add opt-in warmup job for dedicated customers.
ops-bot: Opened incident RI-2205 for pinned-model gap.
release-bot: Final stage (100%) started at 03:30 UTC. Observed overall p99 +18%, errors +0.9%. No SLA breaches.
vivian: Post-drill cleanup:
- remove temporary routing rules
- disable SLO guardrail
- run `kvcache-warmup-global-186523` for 2h
- collect per-customer latency histograms and KV warmup curves
- owners: mark (routing), ryan (warmup), maria (customer comms)
mark: Action items: 1) add fallback variants for 6 pinned models 2) tweak autoscaler cooldowns 3) run follow-up warmup job next Tue.
ryan: I'll draft a short postmortem and link artifacts: canary logs, prom graphs, and warmup curves. Expect draft by EOD.
oncall: Thanks team. If anything unexpected shows in the next 2h, page me. :bell:
